Hi Samir — thanks for the clear ask. Helpful to know the target 60-day window.

High level proposal (draft MAP, attached):
- Week 0: kickoff + access (credentials, test dataset ingest)
- Weeks 1–3: baseline perf tests (latency, throughput) + prompt/eval set creation
- Weeks 4–6: iterative tuning (batching + KV cache config) + quality checks
- Weeks 7–8: pilot run with live traffic shadowing
- Week 9: evaluation readout + decision point

Commercial response to your questions: we can offer a ramped discount tied to a 12-month commit. Typical structure: 10% on signature, additional 5–10% at milestone (30% usage in Q1), final tranche on hitting 70% of committed run-rate. Any discount above 15% requires leadership/CFO review. I need to route an internal approval for anything >15%.

I attached a draft MAP and a placeholder SOW. If you can share your procurement contact (or loop procurement@edgecore.ai), I’ll start the formal paperwork.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll begin internal approval workflows for an 18% conditional discount and get a DocuSign draft ready.

Best,
Ava Chen
